clue.text: Draughts in big country house

definitions.meaning: the board game played with counters on a checked board, known under another name in Britain
the British Prime Minister's official country residence in Buckinghamshire

explanation.walkthrough: Draughts is the British name for checkers; the Prime Minister's country house in Buckinghamshire shares the game's other name.
explanation.definitionFit: The board game of draughts is also called by this name, and it is also the name of the Prime Minister's country retreat.

clue.text: Connection in trendy nightclub

parts.note: hip is slang for fashionable or trendy
a joint is slang for a bar or nightclub

explanation.surface: Someone makes a useful contact at a fashionable club.
explanation.definitionFit: The ball-and-socket articulation where thigh bone meets pelvis is an anatomical connection.

clue.text: Actually left before end of performance

parts.note: to quit is to leave, so left gives the past tense

indicators.note: end of picks out the final letter of the word performance

explanation.surface: Someone really did walk out just before a show finished.
explanation.definitionFit: In the sense 'truly, really' the adverb is a synonym of actually, as in 'it was quite extraordinary'.

clue.text: Rather late in the day, there are lessons to be learnt from them

definitions.text: Rather late in the day, there are lessons to be learnt from them

parts.words: Rather late in the day, there are lessons to be learnt from them
parts.note: reads like a regretful remark about learning too late, but literally describes adult tuition held after work hours

explanation.definitionFit: Courses for adults held after the working day are literally lessons late in the day.

clue.text: Trapeze artist fashionable sort

definitions.meaning: a circus performer who swings on a bar high in the air
dated slang for a lively, trendy person who keeps up with the times

explanation.definitionFit: One who swings on a trapeze, and 1960s slang for a lively, trendy person.

clue.text: Farm animals run away from large black birds

indicators.note: away from tells us the letter for run is taken out of the birds

parts.note: crows are large black birds
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Livestock chase off some big dark birds from a field.
explanation.definitionFit: Female cattle are the classic farmyard livestock.

clue.text: One cleaning old province up after fraud

parts.note: a char is a cleaning lady

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is written from the bottom upwards

parts.note: Natal was a former province of South Africa

explanation.surface: A cleaner tidies up an old region after some swindle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns NATAL into LATAN in this down clue; Natal was a South African province until 1994.
explanation.definitionFit: A charlatan is a quack or impostor, someone guilty of fraud: here the person is meant.

clue.text: Trendy way to serve gin?

definitions.meaning: gin and It is gin mixed with Italian vermouth, so gin comes accompanied by It

explanation.walkthrough: 'It' is short for Italian vermouth, as in the cocktail gin and It.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means fashionable, and gin and It is gin served alongside Italian vermouth.

clue.text: We shall put in complaint in good time about a meat dish

parts.note: a beef is slang for a grievance or complaint
we shall contracts to we'll, written without the apostrophe
on means about, as in a talk on a subject

explanation.surface: We promise to lodge a complaint promptly about a dish.
explanation.walkthrough: The words 'put in' are only joining words here: they just line up the pieces in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Fillet steak wrapped in pastry and mushroom paste is a famous British meat recipe named after the Duke.

clue.text: Priest is gay icon

indicators.note: gay in its old sense of merry or lively signals the letters of priest being jumbled

explanation.surface: A clergyman is held up as a hero by the gay community.
explanation.definitionFit: In computing, a small movable on-screen image or icon is called by this name.

clue.text: One subsequently has penned account that's full of errors?

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: has penned means encloses, so the account goes inside the word for subsequently

parts.note: next means subsequently, afterwards

explanation.surface: Someone later writes up a report riddled with mistakes.
explanation.definitionFit: Something imprecise or incorrect is riddled with mistakes, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Fellow on phone providing insurance

parts.note: cove is old British slang for a man or chap
to ring someone is to phone them

explanation.surface: A man calls up an insurer to take out a policy.
explanation.definitionFit: To give cover is to insure, so the present participle means offering protection against loss.

clue.text: After beginning to feel tired, collapse

indicators.note: beginning to picks out the first letter of the word feel

parts.note: all in is slang for exhausted

explanation.surface: Someone starts to feel weary and then keels over.
explanation.definitionFit: A roof or ceiling that gives way is said to cave or come down, to collapse inwards.

clue.text: German turned out an item of clothing

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of the two words are put out of order

explanation.surface: A man from Germany has turned up wearing a garment.
explanation.definitionFit: Underwear such as a vest or slip is a piece worn beneath outer clothes.

clue.text: Middle of December: husband tucks into nuts and cheese

indicators.note: middle of picks out the two central letters of December
tucks into means goes inside, putting the husband in the word for crazy

parts.note: nuts means crazy, mental

explanation.surface: At Christmas a husband eats nuts and a cheeseboard.
explanation.definitionFit: A Swiss hard cheese with characteristic holes.

clue.text: Spend night away from home, taking shelter in tube?

definitions.meaning: to stay overnight somewhere other than one's own bed
a playful hint at bedding down outdoors, as Londoners once slept in Underground stations

explanation.walkthrough: The tube is London's Underground railway, used as a bomb shelter in the Blitz.
explanation.definitionFit: Staying overnight elsewhere, or sleeping rough as wartime Londoners did in Underground stations.

clue.text: Man harshly expels one with ill-will

parts.note: a man is a male

indicators.note: expels means throws out, so one is removed from the word for harshly

parts.note: violently means harshly, roughly
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A man roughly throws out someone who bears a grudge.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting out of spite or a wish to harm is acting malevolently: an adverb of manner.

clue.text: A guy briefly wearing running top is most absent-minded

indicators.note: wearing means having on, so the vest goes around the other letters

parts.note: a vest is a sleeveless top worn for running

indicators.note: briefly means cut short, so the word guy loses its final letter

parts.note: a guy is a man or fellow

explanation.surface: A forgetful man puts on a jogging vest.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a vest is a sleeveless athletic top.
explanation.definitionFit: Vague can mean dreamy or inattentive, so the superlative means the most distracted.

clue.text: Wine container a waiter finally brought into bistro?

indicators.note: brought into means placed inside the word for bistro

parts.note: a cafe is a small restaurant like a bistro

indicators.note: finally picks out the last letter of the word waiter

explanation.surface: A waiter at last brings wine into a small French restaurant.
explanation.definitionFit: A glass flask for serving wine at table.

clue.text: Rod's touring northern French town

indicators.note: touring means going around, so the rods surround the letter for northern

parts.note: a rod is a cane, and the 's supplies a final S

explanation.surface: Rod is on a trip through the north of France.
explanation.definitionFit: A Riviera resort famous for its film festival.

clue.text: Anxiety suppressed by German criminal

indicators.note: suppressed by means held down inside, so the anxiety sits within the abbreviation

parts.note: angst is anxiety or dread

explanation.surface: A German crook keeps his nerves under control.
explanation.definitionFit: A gangster is a violent member of an organised criminal gang.

clue.text: Meals cooked in witches'place?

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters of meals are prepared into something new

explanation.surface: Witches brew up some dinners in their coven's home.
explanation.definitionFit: The Massachusetts town notorious for its 1692 witch trials.

clue.text: Jumper, perhaps, is an impediment during terrible heat

indicators.note: during means within, so the impediment goes inside the jumbled letters
terrible signals that the letters of heat are messed up

parts.note: a let is an obstruction, as in without let or hindrance

explanation.surface: A woollen sweater proves a hindrance in sweltering weather.
explanation.walkthrough: A jumper is the British word for a sweater, which the surface plays on; the definition means a high or long jumper.
explanation.definitionFit: A high jumper or long jumper is one example of a sportsperson in track and field.

clue.text: Hound breaking ornamental bottles

indicators.note: breaking suggests the answer straddles the break between ornamental and bottles

explanation.surface: A dog knocks over and smashes some decorative bottles.
explanation.definitionFit: An extinct white hunting breed, once used in England, ancestor of the beagle and bloodhound.

clue.text: Betray group of activists, talking aloud

indicators.note: talking aloud signals that the word is chosen for how it is pronounced

parts.note: a cell is a small group of political activists

explanation.surface: An informer gives away his radical comrades by speaking out.
explanation.definitionFit: To sell someone out or sell them down the river is to betray them.

clue.text: Metalworker organised stint with him

indicators.note: organised means arranged, so the letters of stint and him are rearranged

explanation.surface: A craftsman sets up a work shift for a colleague.
explanation.definitionFit: A craftsman who makes and repairs things from thin sheet metal.
